message.content: This vertical magazine cover illustration features a man with white hair, visible forehead wrinkles, and an orange-red tie, wearing a bright yellow blazer with orange lapels. His right arm is raised, palm forward, in a waving gesture. On the lower right of his blazer is a circular green and gold emblem featuring a tree. The background is a solid yellow, with a thick red vertical border on the left edge. Large yellow letters at the top center spell "TEMPO." Above this, black text reads "MAIN POLISI TAIPAN PROPERTI" and "PERANG TEMBAKAU PRODUSEN ROKOK," separated by a thin gray line. Centered across the man’s chest is the bold black text "PIYE KABARE." Smaller black text below reads "PARTAI ANAK SOEHARTO BERTARUNG DALAM PEMILU 2019, SALAH SATU PENGURUSNYA TERPIDANA PEMBUNUH MUNIR." At the bottom left is a white rectangle containing a barcode and the numbers "00001" and "9 770126 427302." Next to the barcode is small black text stating "26 FEBRUARI-4 MARET 2018," "RP 45.000," and other lines of unclear text.
